published.source: Regear and rotation round (branch claude/keen-brown-o2g32n-hunter, 2026-10-23): the 8% hit cap gear, re-searched talents and rotations, race sweep (was 959.6)

summary: Marksmanship with a cat instead of Lone Wolf. The pet deals about 11% of the damage.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 2s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 15 x seconds left
Cat (1.0s) bites and claws on its own; Auto Shot throughout
caveats: Assumed: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power (the client has 50). Hunter's Mark gives 143, the server hotfix (the client has 71).
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP). Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
The pet takes 10% of the hunter's ranged attack power, its crit and its hit, on its own 254 attack power (beta pet sheets).
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (beta log fit: 11% and 3.5%).
Auto Shot fires through casts and winds up 0.5s, which moving cancels.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't active. They would add 13.
Holds Sniper Shot and the weave back for mana; 1140.2 DPS at 300s.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic.
Pet hits scale with attack speed, as a level 17 pet sheet shows. A 1.0s raptor would add about 2 (Savage Rend), but none that fast is known.
A 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Costs 81.9 / 80.4 / 61.3 DPS vs Marksmanship at 120s / 180s / 300s, mostly Serpent Sting's damage.
The sting only lowers the boss's hit by 2%. It adds no raid damage.
notes: Request is hunter__marksmanship's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/mm_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.scorpidSting removed; mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_mm_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_mm, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions.
